interpolation: none; invalid samples drawn as visible gaps
baseline_policy: preserve baseline-valued samples; long runs reported as advisory
display_units: mV scale empirically cross-checked against 12SL R/Q/S amplitude features

grid_spacing.note: Consistent visualization grid; not a certified physical pixel/mm ECG-paper scale

calibration_validation.interpretation: Compares waveform positive maxima with R_Amp and negative minima with the more negative Q_Amp/S_Amp feature. Some differences are expected because a global waveform extreme is not always the exact annotated wave peak. This is an empirical consistency check, not independent laboratory calibration.

quality_warning: Technical/advisory flags are not clinical ECG-quality diagnoses.
